players.bio: Aaron Thomas James (born 30 June 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship side Wrexham.
Anthony William Patterson (born 10 May 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Wrexham. He has represented England U21 internationally.

Arthur Chukwuezugo Okonkwo (born 9 September 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic on loan from EFL Championship club Wrexham. Born in England, he plays for the Nigeria national team.
Bailey-Tye Cadamarteri (born 9 May 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Wrexham. Born in England, he plays for the Jamaica national team.
Benjamin David Sheaf (born 5 February 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Wrexham. He has represented England at youth level.
Benjamin Whiteman (born 17 June 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Wrexham.
Callum Alex David Burton (born 15 August 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Wrexham. He also represented England up to under-18 level.

Callum Craig Doyle (born 3 October 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Wrexham. Beginning his career with Manchester City, Doyle spent loan spells with Sunderland, Coventry City, and Leicester City.

Callum Luke O'Hare (born 1 May 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Wrexham. He has previously played for Sheffield United, Coventry City and Aston Villa, as well as a loan spell with Carlisle United.
Daniel Edward Peter Imray (born 27 July 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for EFL Championship club Wrexham.

Daniel Ward (born 22 June 1993) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Wrexham and the Wales national team. Ward has previously played for Liverpool and Leicester City, as well as having loan spells at Tamworth, Morecambe, Aberdeen and Huddersfield Town. He was first called up to the Welsh national team in 2013 and made his debut in 2016.

Dominic John Hyam (born 20 December 1995) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Wrexham and the Scotland national team. He is known as a reliable, robust and consistent centre-back. Starting his career at Reading, he played on loan for Hemel Hempstead Town, Basingstoke Town, Dagenham & Redbridge and Aldershot Town.

George David Dobson (born 15 November 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Wrexham. He is a versatile player who can play as a defensive midfielder or as a centre-back, having mainly played as the latter as a youth player.
George Andrew Thomason (born 12 January 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship side Wrexham.
Issa Kaboré (born 12 May 2001) is a Burkinabé professional footballer who plays as a right-back or right wing-back for EFL Championship club Wrexham and the Burkina Faso national team.

Joseph Adrian Worrall is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Wrexham. Worrall has also represented England at youth level, and captained the England squad that won the 2017 Toulon Tournament.. Worrall signed with Nottingham Forest in October 2011, rejecting interest from other local sides Derby County and Leicester City.

Joshua Dean Windass (born 9 January 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder and forward for EFL Championship club Wrexham. Windass was born in Hull, East Riding of Yorkshire, and is the son of former professional Dean Windass.

Kieffer Roberto Francisco Moore (born 8 August 1992) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Wrexham and the Wales national team. Moore started his career with Conference South club Truro City, having as a teen been a part of Torquay United's youth system and playing for South Devon League Division Two club Paignton Saints.
Lewis John O'Brien (born 14 October 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Wrexham.
Liberato Gianpaolo Cacace ( kə-KAH-chee; born 27 September 2000) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Wrexham and the New Zealand national team.
Matthew Lee James (born 22 July 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Wrexham. His regular position is in midfield, but he can play in defence when required.
Max Cleworth ( KLOO-wərth; born 9 August 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Wrexham.
Nathan Paul Broadhead (born 5 April 1998) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a forward or left winger for EFL Championship club Wrexham and the Wales national team.
Oliver Michael Rathbone (born 10 October 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL Championship club Wrexham.
Philip John Parkinson (born 1 December 1967) is an English professional football manager and former player who played as a midfielder. He was most recently manager of League One club Sunderland.
Ryan James Longman (born 6 November 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays primarily as a winger for EFL Championship club Wrexham.
Samuel Toby Smith (born 8 March 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Wrexham.

Sebastian Revan (born 14 July 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Wrexham. A product of the Aston Villa academy, he featured for Villa's U21s in the EFL Trophy in 2020–21 and was also part of the winning FA Youth Cup team of the same season.
Zachary George Onyego Vyner (born 14 May 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Wrexham.
